svg.aria-label: How a Generalized ADCS simulation fits together: ADCS.simulate propagates the orbit and environment and closes the loop from the satellite's sensors, through an attitude estimator and a controller that tracks a goal, back to the actuators. The results feed plots, the Godot viewer and Monte Carlo campaigns.
